note: Cabins and a six-site campground on 32 acres of Loess Hills woodland, across Plum Ave from Savery Pond and minutes from Preparation Canyon State Park. Grassy back-in sites with gravel pads, not all equally level; the nearest water fill and dump station are at Pisgah City Park, about 15 minutes away. Reached by about three miles of gravel road from Peach Ave (signed from Hwy 183 four miles north of Pisgah); very limited cell service. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $45 (1-2 adults, tax included; CampLife quotes $46.35 one night with the card fee), six back-in 30-amp sites fitting 32 ft, no water/sewer, year-round. Added showers/flush toilets/laundry, no on-site dump/potable water/WiFi, CampLife deep link, and the engine's posted 2-night minimum. Not waterfront stands.
